subject: Problem with the help of RW_PF_block?

messages.author: bc11fbb928eb77ff
messages.subject: Problem with the help of RW_PF_block?
parts:
Hi again,

 i was suprised by the following specification of the help of samplers (actually here for RW_PF_Block):

adaptScaleOnly. A logical argument, specifying whether adaption should be done only for scale (TRUE) or also for provCov (FALSE). This argument is only relevant when adaptive = TRUE. When adaptScaleOnly = FALSE, both scale and propCov undergo adaptation; the sampler tunes the scaling to achieve a theoretically good acceptance rate, and the proposal covariance to mimic that of the empirical samples. When adaptScaleOnly = FALSE, only the proposal scale is adapted. (default = FALSE)

I guess in the last line you should replace adaptScaleOnly = FALSE by:
adaptScaleOnly = TRUE

Am I correct?

If so the same error occurs throughout.

Sincerely,

Frédéric Gosselin

messages.author: 99aa11b224ba9e9e
messages.subject: Re: Problem with the help of RW_PF_block?
parts: Yes Frédéric, you are entirely correct.  Thanks for the careful eye.  It's been fixed in our development branch, and this will be included in our next release.
